summary:
[  edit  ]
The Replace  CHOP  can be used to replace channels very quickly. The output of channels in  Input1  will be replaced by channels found in  Input2  if a matching channel exists in Input2. Any channels that are in Input1 and not in Input2 will be output without being replaced.
You can also use this to quickly delete channels (this method can be faster than the  Delete CHOP ). To do this send all the channels to Input2, then send the channels you want to keep to Input1.

What are POPs? - **Definition**: POPs (Point Operators) are a family of operators in TouchDesigner that run on the GPU, leveraging high parallelism to create and manipulate 3D data efficiently. - **Purpose**: They generate and modify points, primitives, and attributes for rendering (via Render TOP) or output to external devices like LED arrays or lasers. - **Significance**: POPs replace SOPs with GPU acceleration, memory optimization, and integration with modern workflows (e.g., USD, FBX). ## 2.
